perks.name: Subsistence
perks.description: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves.

enhanced.name: Subsistence
enhanced.description: Defeating targets partially reloads the magazine from reserves with an increased amount of ammo.

perks.name: Auto-Loading Holster
perks.description: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after a short period of time.

enhanced.name: Auto-Loading Holster
enhanced.description: The holstered weapon is automatically reloaded after an improved short period of time.

perks.name: Ambitious Assassin
perks.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid kills before reloading.

enhanced.name: Ambitious Assassin
enhanced.description: Overflows the magazine based on the number of rapid final blows before reloading. Improves reload.

perks.name: Demolitionist
perks.description: Kills with this weapon generate grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

enhanced.name: Demolitionist
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon generate an improved amount of grenade energy. Activating your grenade ability reloads this weapon from reserves.

perks.name: Discord
perks.description: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed for aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a short time. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

enhanced.name: Discord
enhanced.description: Final blows with another weapon grant this weapon increased speed aiming down sights, accuracy, and airborne effectiveness for a longer duration. When Discord is active, final blows refund ammo.

perks.name: Feeding Frenzy
perks.description: Each rapid kill with this weapon progressively increases reload speed for a short time.

enhanced.name: Feeding Frenzy
enhanced.description: Each rapid final blow with this weapon progressively increases reload speed substantially for a short time.

perks.name: Blast Distributor
perks.description: Dealing splash damage grants a bonus to Grenade stat.

enhanced.name: Blast Distributor
enhanced.description: Dealing splash damage grants an improved bonus to Grenade stat.

perks.name: Bipod
perks.description: Increases ammo and reserves but reduces damage, blast radius, and reload speed.

enhanced.name: Bipod
enhanced.description: Increases ammo and reserves but reduces damage. Blast radius and reload speed are slightly reduced.

perks.name: Chill Clip
perks.description: Direct hits with the top half of the magazine cause a detonation that slows nearby targets.

enhanced.name: Chill Clip
enhanced.description: Direct hits with the majority of the magazine cause a detonation that slows nearby targets.

perks.name: Collective Demolition
perks.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of grenade energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

enhanced.name: Collective Demolition
enhanced.description:
Collecting an Elemental pickup or destroying a Tangle grants this weapon a stacking period of improved grenade energy generation on hit. Throwing a Tangle provides additional time.

Elemental pickups include [Solar]Firesprites, [Void]Void Breaches, [Arc]Ionic Traces, [Stasis]Stasis Shards, and [Strand]Strand Tangles.

perks.name: Chain Reaction
perks.description: Each final blow with this weapon creates an elemental damage explosion.

enhanced.name: Chain Reaction
enhanced.description: Each final blow with this weapon creates an improved elemental damage explosion.

perks.name: Rampage
perks.description: Kills with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage. Stacks 3x.

enhanced.name: Rampage
enhanced.description: Final blows with this weapon grant increased damage for an improved duration. Stacks 3 times.

flavor: We are all burdened by the chains of our past.
